commsToast.warm: "Good morning, 1419. Quick question: did you also wake up forty-one thousand years late, or is that just me?"
commsToast.mid: "Relay window's open. Got a weird smudge on my glass I want a second pair of eyes on."
commsToast.shift2TheyLive: "Stop looking at visible stars. Slide your filter into Near-IR on J1419-A right now."
